mapper.insert: INSERT INTO after_sale_attachment (ticket_id, url, uploaded_by, uploader_role) VALUES (#{ticketId}, #{url}, #{uploadedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{uploaderRole,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ticket_id, url, uploaded_by, uploader_role, created_at FROM after_sale_attachment WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM after_sale_attachment WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId}
